description: Manages various lookup and reference data points used across the system, providing lists of predefined options for different categories like currencies, countries, and application types.

endpoints.name: GetCurrencies
endpoints.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of all available currencies supported by the system, including their codes and names.
example_uses: How can I get a list of all supported currencies?
Show me the currency codes and names.
I need to see all currency options for a dropdown.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to populate a dropdown, validate currency inputs, or display a list of valid currency options within the application.

endpoints.name: GetEligibleEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of entities that are deemed eligible for specific operations, classifications, or partnerships within the system.
example_uses: What are the eligible entities in the system?
List all entities that qualify for this program.
I need to see the list of eligible organizations.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of entities that meet specific eligibility criteria, typically for selection or filtering purposes in business processes.

endpoints.name: GetCountries
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all recognized countries, often including their ISO codes and full names.
example_uses: Can you give me a list of all countries?
Show me the country codes and names.
I need to select a country from a list for an address.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to populate a dropdown or display a list of valid country options, typically for address, location, or demographic selection.

endpoints.name: GetApplicationTypes
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all defined application types used within the system, categorizing different forms or processes.
example_uses: What are the different application types available?
List all available application categories.
I need to know the types of applications supported by the system.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of predefined application types for classification, filtering, or guiding users through different application processes.

endpoints.name: GetPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a basic list of all registered partners. This endpoint is for lookup purposes (e.g., partner names and IDs) and does not provide detailed partner management capabilities.
example_uses: List all partners.
Show me the names of all partners.
I need a simple list of partners for a report.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a simple list of partners, typically for selection in other forms or reports, not for detailed partner information or comprehensive management.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationUnits
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all organizational units or departments within the system's structure.
example_uses: What are the organizational units?
List all departments in the company.
I need to see the structure of the organization.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of organizational units, typically for assigning responsibilities, filtering data by department/unit, or understanding the organizational hierarchy.

endpoints.name: GetContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a basic list of all registered contacts. This endpoint is for lookup purposes (e.g., contact names and IDs) and does not provide detailed contact management capabilities.
example_uses: List all contacts.
Show me the names of all contacts.
I need a simple list of contacts for a communication.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a simple list of contacts, typically for selection in other forms or reports, not for detailed contact information or comprehensive management.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a basic list of all registered users in the system. This endpoint is for lookup purposes (e.g., user names and IDs) and does not provide detailed user management capabilities.
example_uses: List all users.
Show me the names of all system users.
I need a simple list of users for access control.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a simple list of users, typically for selection in other forms or reports, not for detailed user information or comprehensive management.

endpoints.name: GetGeminiModels
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available Gemini AI models that can be integrated or utilized by the system.
example_uses: What Gemini models are available?
List all AI models I can use.
I need to know which Gemini models are supported.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of available Gemini AI models for integration, configuration, or selection purposes within AI-driven features.
